zh-Hans.description:
Drel 是面向 iPhone 开发者的推送通知工具，也是运行可信 HTML 应用的安全容器。

• 复制个人推送地址，用脚本、浏览器、自动化或自己的服务发出通知
• 点击包含 HTTPS 目标地址的通知，直接打开指定页面
• 在收件箱查看你选择打开的通知
• 为已签名且经你信任的 HTML 应用启用固定、可审计的受限原生操作
• 剪贴板、位置和运动传感器权限单独授权，并可随时在权限中心撤销

1.5.0 为可信应用提供八种原生操作：触感、震动、分享、沉浸全屏、剪贴板、位置、添加到主页和运动传感器。网页必须在用户前台点按后调用；未声明的操作、后台调用和不受信任页面会被拒绝。Drel 提供的是固定清单，不是通用 JavaScript 到原生 Bridge，也不会远程新增原生能力。

Drel 面向使用自有服务的开发者。它不是公开应用市场，也不是通用浏览器。

Built with WebBridgeKit.
zh-Hans.keywords: 开发者,推送,通知,Webhook,HTML,开发者工具
zh-Hans.promotionalText: 受控的 HTML 应用原生操作现已上线；剪贴板、位置和运动传感器可单独授权、随时撤销。
zh-Hans.whatsNew:
Drel 1.5.0 更新

• 原生操作声明：可信 HTML 应用可在签名 Manifest 中声明触感、震动、分享、沉浸全屏、添加到主页、剪贴板、位置和运动传感器
• 更清晰的操作边界：声明只是能力清单，不等于长期授权，也不代表用户已同意交出隐私数据
• 前台手势触发：网页必须在用户点按后的短时间内调用，后台或未声明操作会被拒绝
• 分享更透明：每次分享都打开 iOS 系统分享面板，由你检查内容并选择去向
• 沉浸全屏更清晰：左侧箭头只收起工具条，× 关闭网页，左边缘向右滑返回网页历史且不会误退出
• 运动传感器可用于游戏：可信应用在你授权后订阅加速度计和陀螺仪事件；撤销授权会立即停止数据流
• 剪贴板、位置与传感器由你授权：可信应用读取这些数据前，Drel 会单独征求你的同意
• 授权随时可撤：已授予的剪贴板、位置和运动传感器权限集中在权限中心，撤销后立即生效
• 能力范围保持克制：扫码、相册、蓝牙、麦克风、通讯录等敏感能力仍未开放

en-US.description:
Drel is a push-notification utility for iPhone developers and a secure container for trusted HTML apps.

• Copy a personal push address and send from a script, browser, automation, or your own service
• Open an HTTPS destination directly from the notification you tap
• Review the notifications you choose to open in Inbox
• Enable a fixed, auditable set of native actions for signed HTML apps you explicitly trust
• Grant clipboard, location, and motion-sensor access separately, and revoke any one from the permission center

Version 1.5.0 provides eight actions to trusted apps: haptic feedback, vibration, sharing, immersive fullscreen, clipboard, location, add-to-Home-Screen, and motion sensors. Pages must call an action after a foreground tap; undeclared actions, background calls, and untrusted pages are rejected. Drel exposes a fixed allowlist, not a general JavaScript-to-native Bridge, and cannot add native capabilities remotely.

Drel is built for developers using their own services. It is not a public app marketplace or a general-purpose browser.

Built with WebBridgeKit.
en-US.promotionalText: Controlled native actions for trusted HTML apps are here, with separately revocable clipboard, location, and motion-sensor grants.
en-US.whatsNew:
What’s new in Drel 1.5.0

• Declared native actions: trusted HTML apps can declare haptic, vibrate, share, immersive fullscreen, add-to-home-screen, clipboard, location, and motion sensors in an Ed25519-signed manifest
• Clearer boundaries: a declaration is an action inventory, not a long-term grant of user privacy
• Foreground-gesture requirement: pages must call an action shortly after a user tap; undeclared or background calls are rejected
• Transparent sharing: every share opens the native iOS share sheet so you review the content and choose the destination
• Clearer fullscreen controls: the edge arrow only collapses the toolbar, × closes the page, and a left-edge rightward swipe returns through page history without exiting
• Motion sensors can drive games: a trusted app can subscribe to accelerometer and gyroscope events after you grant access, and revoking access stops the stream immediately
• Clipboard, location, and motion sensors need your permission: when a trusted app asks for them, Drel asks you separately
• Revoke any time: granted clipboard, location, and motion-sensor permissions live in one permission center, and revoking sensors stops the stream immediately
• Restrained capability scope: camera scanning, photos, Bluetooth, microphone, contacts, and other sensitive actions remain unavailable
